/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import subprocess

path = Path('index.html')
source = path.read_text()
assert source.startswith('<"'!DOCTYPE html>'"')
assert source.rstrip().endswith('</html>')
class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.module = False
        self.javascript = []
        self.inputs = []
        self.titles = []
        self.in_title = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'script' and attrs.get('type') == 'module':
            self.module = True
        if tag == 'input':
            self.inputs.append((attrs['name'], attrs.get('value')))
        if tag == 'title':
            self.in_title = True
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'script':
            self.module = False
        if tag == 'title':
            self.in_title = False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.module:
            self.javascript.append(data)
        if self.in_title:
            self.titles.append(data)
parser = PageParser()
parser.feed(source)
assert parser.titles == ['GPT-6']
assert len(parser.inputs) == 17
assert 'Math.random' not in ''.join(parser.javascript)
check = subprocess.run(['node', '--check', '--input-type=module'], input=''.join(parser.javascript), text=True, capture_output=True)
if check.returncode:
    print(check.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(check.returncode)
print(f'index.html: {len(source.encode()):,} bytes. HTML boundaries, model title, 17 settings inputs, and JavaScript syntax verified. No simulation executed.')
PY"
